methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
REGENT Craft is a Series A–stage transportation company founded by Billy Thalheimer and Mike Klinker that has raised $60M to date. The broader transportation sector comprises 8 private peers (including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero) and zero public comparables, though a sufficiently narrow peer set at the same stage and valuation tier does not exist to support a reliable median methodology.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A–to–next-stage advancement. Using the $60M total raised as a proxy baseline, this yields an implied valuation of $120M. The peer-median approach is not applicable; while three transportation-sector peers exist in the available universe, none satisfy the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables necessary to generate a defensible median (minimum three datapoints required).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $102M to $138M, centered on $120M, derived from the single applicable methodology. This range reflects standard confidence bands around the stage-progression result but should be weighted with appropriate skepticism given reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include the absence of true peer comparables at REGENT's stage and tier, limiting cross-validation, and the inherent variability in stage-multiplier assumptions across different investor bases and market conditions. Additional traction metrics or refined peer identification would strengthen conviction in this range.
